subject: Web Development
title: Progressive Web Apps
description: A fast breakdown of Progressive Web Apps for builders.

hook.text: What if a website could work offline, send push alerts, and feel like a native app?

buildup.text: Google proposed Progressive Web Apps in 2015 — websites with app-like powers.

discovery.text: Service workers let sites cache content and function without an internet connection.

twist.text: Apple dragged its feet on PWA support, protecting App Store revenue.

climax.text: PWAs proved the web could close the gap with native apps, no download required.

quiz.question: What technology lets PWAs work offline?
